idea-plugin.name: Kubernetes with SSH
idea-plugin.description:
IntelliJ IDEA plugin that provides access to remote Kubernetes clusters over SSH.
Features:
  • Multiple SSH profiles: create, duplicate, rename, delete, and switch between multiple remote SSH servers seamlessly.
  • Configurable SSH credentials (Password & Private Key) and remote kubectl path in Settings.
  • Right-side Tool Window to monitor and manage Kubernetes pods.
  • Namespace switcher and real-time namespace explorer.
  • Pod statuses, readiness, container images, image IDs, restart counts, age, node, and IP inspection.
  • Docker Images tab displaying remote Docker/container images (Repository, Tag, Image ID, Created, Size).
  • Quick navigation button from Pods to Docker Images with instant search filtering.
  • Create new Docker image tags or change/update existing image tags directly from the UI.
  • Automatic 5-second background refresh for both Pods and Docker Images with selection preservation.
  • Delete pod, force delete pod, and delete/inspect Docker images with safety confirmations.
  • View Pod logs and Describe pod details directly in the IDE.
  • Execute an interactive terminal inside any pod with container/shell switching, live bidirectional PTY streaming, ANSI color styling, and quick command execution.
  • Edit Kubernetes Deployments: interactive YAML manifest editor, dry-run validation, replica scaling, container image updating, and rollout restart.
  • Live pod search and filtering.
